say:1:1610631101:1.text: Lavish attire? A name immediately comes to your mind: Aurelian, the wealthy merchant. His bearing is impossible to forget.
say:1:1610631101:1.source_cn: 一位穿着华丽服装的男士？你突然想到了一个人——那个名叫...

say:2:1610631102:1.text: Could it actually be him? You hold your breath and listen closely to the interrogation.
say:2:1610631102:1.source_cn: 那个签订契约的人，会是他吗？你屏住气，继续听他们的对话。
